_comment: FIG-02 parity oracle (Phase 236 plan 08). Closed-form series read by BOTH tests/test_annualization_parity.py and src/__tests__/annualization-parity.test.ts. Expected values are derived from the closed forms in each vector's _comment and computed with plain math arithmetic, never from an engine. A series is the repeating pair [+0.02,-0.01] (even length, phase 0): mean 0.005, sample sd 0.015*sqrt(n/(n-1)). No vector carries a leg of an unknown asset class.

vectors.name: crypto_24_7
vectors._comment: n=730 consecutive calendar days, P=365. mean=0.005 (each pair sums to 0.01 over 2 obs). Every deviation is +-0.015 so SS=n*0.015^2 and sd=0.015*sqrt(n/(n-1)). sharpe=0.005/sd*sqrt(365). twr=(1.02*0.99)^(365)-1. span=last-first=729 days, cagr=(1+twr)^(365/729)-1.

vectors.name: weekday_gaps
vectors._comment: n=520 weekdays (104 whole weeks from Monday 2023-01-02 to Friday 2024-12-27); weekends have NO row. P=252. Same closed forms with n=520. span=104*7-3=725 days (last Friday minus first Monday), which is not n-1=519, so cagr=(1+twr)^(365/725)-1.

vectors.name: broken_chain_suffix
vectors._comment: 200 prefix days of [+0.05,-0.02] on days 0..199, ONE NaN day (the interior break) on day 200, then a 300-day suffix of [+0.02,-0.01] on days 201..500. Only the suffix is the oracle series: n=300, span=500-201=299 days, P=365. mean=0.005, sd=0.015*sqrt(300/299), twr=(1.02*0.99)^150-1, cagr=(1+twr)^(365/299)-1. The engines that take the suffix themselves are fed the whole chain; the TS engines are fed the suffix (suffix_first_date).

vectors.name: emptied_stretch
vectors._comment: 400 observations of the repeating pair on days 0..199 and 300..499; days 200..299 have NO row (an emptied stretch, never a NaN, so the chain is NOT broken). P=365. Q1: the calendar span INCLUDES the stretch, span=499 days, so cagr=(1+twr)^(365/499)-1. The pair phase restarts at 0 after the gap because the 200 observations before it are an even count. mean=0.005, sd=0.015*sqrt(400/399), twr=(1.02*0.99)^200-1.
